A Long Awaited and Delicious, Fun Dinner
Oct 2026 • Couples
We've been wanting to come to Watr for years, ever since an SLS hotel ambassador recommended it as one of his favorite places. I looked at the prices back then and was deterred. Years later, we'd saved up and were finally staying at 1 Hotel South Beach and having dinner at Watr! It felt very special to be here.

The rooftop restaurant had a wonderful atmosphere, with trees wrapped in lights, comfortable couches, and a lively mix of diners. The DJ played a fun techno beat at just the right volume, creating an upbeat vibe while still allowing us to have a conversation. I really appreciated that. The clientele was mostly younger and hip, nicely dressed. 

Our waiter, Joel, was enthusiastic, warm, and genuinely enjoyable to talk with. We especially appreciated his suggestion to order a couple of dishes first and decide afterward whether we wanted more, rather than ordering everything at once. His thoughtful advice and friendly personality made our long-awaited dinner even more enjoyable.

The Ora King Salmon Tataki was good, with a lovely buttery mouthfeel, but the portion consisted of just five small, bite-sized slices of salmon. I felt a bit ripped off by the price and initially worried that the tuna tartare and other dishes would be similarly tiny. 

When the Bluefin Tuna Tartare, arrived, it was a really good size and yummy - it was a winner! There was a generous amount of fresh tuna and avocado, accompanied by enough lavash and rice crisps to provide a nice contrast in texture and flavor. It was delicious, satisfying, and a good value.

We also ordered the Wagyu Beef Roll without the shishito peppers. It was so tasty and filling, and we were glad we'd followed Joel's advice about ordering as we went.

For dessert, we enjoyed a selection of mochi in passion fruit, mango, and chocolate flavors (you pick the flavors), served with strawberries and blackberries. It was a nice way to finish the meal.

Our dinner came to over $250, including gratuity. It certainly wasn't an inexpensive evening for sushi, but after wanting to visit for so many years, I was glad we finally did.

On a side note about the all-gender bathrooms, there were several open cubicles that are open to the air at the top of the stalls but under their own roof area, so you won't get rained on when you are there. I liked that the fresh air was flowing through them. I did walk over to see the sunset, but with the air conditioning units, it wasn't quite the panoramic view I was expecting. 

Between the beautiful rooftop setting, enjoyable music, delicious tuna tartare, and Joel's wonderful hospitality, Watr was a memorable experience. It was a lovely, delicious, long awaited evening and well worth the wait!

Watr is GORGEOUS! I'm upset I didn't take pictures other than at the table w/ my friends, but we ended up staying longer than we planned b/c we were having such a fun night.

I'm a local and I must say I'm gonna have to add Watr to a favorite go-to spot. My friends and I had a 7pm reservation. We got there late, past 15mins on the weekend of Halloween and to my surprise, they still accommodated us! To further add to the night, we were seated at a table by the bar and had THE MOST PHENOMENAL service the whole night by Jimmy. Jimmy is AWESOME and COMPLETEY helped to make the night one of my most fun in a LONG time.

I've been out plenty of times since COVID and good service has been lacking, by far. I don't know what Jimmy's plans are in the future, but Watr will be missing a valuable employee whenever he chooses to move on. From what I saw, he had appx 5 tables he was servicing (maybe more) and not once did my friends and I feel lacking. He was attentive, friendly, quick, ALWAYS had a smile on his face and followed up to make sure everything was ok every single time we ordered something new. He made us feel like VIP customers. I had to ask one of my friends if we were in the VIP section?! His service was that good and when I looked around at the other tables, I saw no annoyed faces. Jimmy's service was so good, it prompted us to tell the manager, Angel, how great Jimmy was. Not for nothing, Angel was wonderful as well. He patiently listened to us rave over Jimmy even though Watr was becoming fuller by the minute. They were hosting a Halloween party and I know Angel had to be busy. He had a great attitude and was far from being pretentious or condescending. 

If I could roll the clock back a few hours, I would take pictures. I'm soooo disappointed I didn't. When my gf said Watr had spectacular views, she was right. The rooftop was GORGEOUS; the hotel is beautiful. Walking through the lobby, I was impressed. I don't know how new the hotel is (I didn't know it existed), but I'll make it one of my hang out spots from now on. At 1st glance you would think One Hotel is too pretty, too sleek to be inviting and a great place to chill especially b/c it's located in Miami Beach. It's a more sophisticated crowd. I saw all ages there... people in their 20s right up to older gentlemen that could be past 50. My girlfriends and I are in our 40s and we didn't feel out of place. We were able to mingle and chat w/ a lot of people. We were able to have conversations a couple next to us and a group of guys that come over. We people watched, had really great cocktails (the bartenders were really good) and ate great food. I had a steak bowl and the meat was tender and seasoned to perfection. Everything in the bowl came together soo well! We also had their signature roll... a must have.

There is not a single thing I can complain about and I'm not easily impressed. One is a beautiful hotel. There's a bar and restaurant in the lobby, along w/ scattered seating, so downstairs is another place to chill and socialize. Watr is spectacular, good food, great drinks, wonderful service, beautiful views, nice people. None of the servers had stuck-up looks on their faces. The rooftop is large, according to my friends, so I'm definitely going back in the daytime to check it out. It looks like a great place to brunch w/ the girls or a place I know I can take my mom. We like to try different outdoor venues when we go out to eat. I know my family will enjoy the pool. It just seems like a great place to chill for any occasion and any crowd. 

One more thing, Watr validates your valet parking! Locals know how wonderful this is. 😉
